name: @deurge/desktop
description: deUrge desktop shell (Tauri 2 + system WebView) — offline, local-only recovery tracker.
author: deUrge contributors

scripts.dist:linux: pnpm --filter @deurge/web build && tauri build --bundles appimage,deb,rpm && node ../../scripts/collect-tauri-artifacts.mjs linux
scripts.dist:win: pnpm --filter @deurge/web build && tauri build --bundles nsis,msi && node ../../scripts/collect-tauri-artifacts.mjs windows
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm --filter @deurge/web build && tauri build --bundles dmg && node ../../scripts/collect-tauri-artifacts.mjs macos
